 New York (HQ)
 





 Engineering

**About QuickSecure** 




 When something goes wrong in a school, the people running toward the building often know less than the parents in the parking lot. Police arriving with outdated floor plans. Paramedics looking for room numbers over scratchy radios. Teachers locked in classrooms with no idea who’s coming, or when.
 



  





 The day\-to\-day isn’t much better. Anonymous tips dropped in paper boxes. Lockdown drills tracked on clipboards. Emergency alerts sent by group text and intercom. The tools schools use to keep millions of children safe haven’t changed in twenty years.
 



  





 Come help us fix that. We arm first responders with the information they need in the moments that matter most, and give schools the tools to prevent those moments in the first place.
 



  





 We’re building the operating system for modern school safety: emergency response, AI threat detection, anonymous tip lines, mass communication, and the hardware that ties it all together.
 



  





 We're live with customers across the country, growing fast and looking for people who want to be part of what comes next.
 



  





**About the role** 




 This is our first new grad role. By week one, you’ll have code running live in our schools. By month one, you’ll have sat across from a principal or SRO and learned what they actually need. By quarter one, you own real parts of the platform. You’re working alongside the founders and the engineering team, all of whom care deeply about helping you grow.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




 • Ship features across our platforms: frontend, backend, mobile, and edge computing systems
 



 • Work on real customer problems from start to finish
 



  





**Our tech stack** 




 TypeScript and JavaScript end\-to\-end (Node/Express \+ React) with React Native and Swift on mobile, Postgres for data, all hosted on AWS. We use Anthropic, Gemini, and in\-house vision models. You’ll be working with all of it.
 



  





**Who you are** 




 • Graduating in 2025 or 2026 with a degree in computer science.
 



 • Strong understanding and an instinct for reliability. The systems we build run during the worst moments of a school year, and they have to work the first time.
 



 • A tinkerer. Someone who isn’t afraid to get their hands dirty and learn what they don’t already know.
 



 • Comfortable with the weight of the domain. We build for K\-12 schools, which means our bugs can have real consequences. Some people love that, some don’t. Make sure you do.
 



 • You build because you want to. Hackathons, side projects, open source, that one class assignment you couldn’t stop iterating on, or an internship you keep thinking about. Send us your favorite.
 



 • Office over remote, every time. We’re in Chinatown five days a week and that’s where you’ll grow fastest.
 



  





**First 90 days** 




 You’ll learn the product inside and out, help us with customer deployments in August, work alongside our engineering team and founders to strengthen the current product, and start owning and shipping new features.
 



  





**Why this role** 




 • Start shipping from day one, no 90 day learning period
 



 • Work on some of the hardest problems out there, and ones that are tangible.
 



 • Touch both software and hardware in the same week
 



 • Be part of a well\-funded startup ready to scale
 



  





**Compensation and benefits** 




 • $100,000–$120,000 base, based on experience, plus meaningful equity in an early stage startup
 



 • Work on the hardest problems with the most rewarding solutions
 



 • Take unlimited PTO as needed
 



 • Beautiful office in the heart of Chinatown

By automating complex insurance billing, credentialing, and clinical documentation using AI, you will directly increase healthcare capacity for the 1 in 6 children needing therapy. This is a high\-ownership, 0→1 role shipping production code daily.
   

  

**Location**
 San Francisco, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Shape the entire technical stack and product culture from day one as one of the first engineering hires in an in\-person SF mission office.
* Drive massive real\-world impact by reducing therapist administrative burdens by 90%, allowing more children to receive critical care faster.
* Work alongside a high\-velocity team backed by leading early\-stage investors, already supporting over 75 therapists with active care operations.


**What You Will Do**
* Own the full development lifecycle from initial concept to deployment, making critical product and technical decisions for the core platform.
* Build and refine AI\-driven workflows using TypeScript, React, and Langchain to automate insurance claims and clinical note\-taking.
* Interface directly with therapists to observe workflows and translate user pain points into seamless, automated software solutions.


**The ideal candidate**
* Proven experience building and shipping complex, full\-stack applications from scratch in a fast\-paced startup or 0→1 environment.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React, with a deep interest in leveraging LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate development velocity.
* High\-agency mindset with a preference for shipping and iterating quickly over long\-form design cycles or rigid specifications.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

**About The Company**
 V\-Soft Consulting Group Inc is a leading technology services provider recognized among the top 100 fastest growing staffing companies in North America. Headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, V\-Soft has established a strong presence with strategic locations across India, Canada, and the United States. The company specializes in delivering innovative IT solutions, staffing, and consulting services to a diverse portfolio of clients, including numerous Fortune 500 companies. Known for its agility and commitment to excellence, V\-Soft fosters a dynamic work environment that encourages professional growth and technological advancement. The organization prides itself on its robust partnerships across various technology stacks, enabling it to stay at the forefront of industry trends and deliver tailored solutions for complex business challenges.
   

  

**About The Role**
 V\-Soft Consulting is seeking a highly skilled Senior Fullstack Developer to join our team remotely. This role is pivotal in supporting and modernizing critical legacy systems that underpin freight operations, rolling stock maintenance, detector systems, hub movements, terminal activities, and container flows from origin to destination. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in full\-stack development, with a backend\-heavy focus, and possess a deep understanding of Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and event\-driven architectures. You will work closely with mechanical, hub, and terminal teams to replatform and enhance high\-volume distributed systems that process over 30 million data points from detectors and sensors. The role demands a proactive, independent professional capable of leading projects from design through deployment, mentoring junior developers, and supporting both new builds and ongoing system modernization initiatives. The position offers the flexibility of remote work, providing an excellent opportunity to contribute to large\-scale enterprise modernization projects within a forward\-thinking organization.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should possess 6 to 10 years of comprehensive full\-stack development experience, with a strong emphasis on backend technologies. Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot is essential, along with experience working with Kafka and implementing event\-driven architectures. Candidates should have a solid background in relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or similar systems. Cloud experience is required, with a preference for AWS, though Azure experience is acceptable. Proficiency in Python for backend development or data workflows is highly desirable. Candidates should also have experience modernizing legacy microservices and distributed systems, supporting both new development and system enhancement projects. Familiarity with IoT, high\-volume data pipelines, sensors, or detector systems is a plus. Additionally, a DevSecOps mindset emphasizing automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and secure coding practices is required. Excellent communication skills, the ability to mentor junior developers, and proven leadership in full\-stack project delivery are vital for success in this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Fullstack Developer, your primary responsibilities will include supporting the modernization of large\-scale legacy systems that facilitate freight operations, maintenance, and data ingestion from detectors and sensors. You will lead efforts to replatform and optimize over 600 rulesets, ensuring seamless integration and high\-performance processing of high\-volume data streams. Your role involves designing, developing, and deploying scalable microservices, supporting both new feature development and system upgrades. You will work with IoT data ingestion pipelines, high\-volume detector data, and distributed systems processing over 30 million data points, ensuring reliability, security, and efficiency. Mentoring junior developers and providing technical guidance will be key aspects of your role. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and oversee the deployment and maintenance of full\-stack applications. Additionally, you will support continuous improvement initiatives by implementing DevSecOps practices, automated testing, and secure coding standards to ensure system robustness and compliance.
   

  

**Benefits**
 V\-Soft Consulting offers a comprehensive benefits package to support your well\-being and professional growth. As a valued employee, you will receive full medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with a competitive 401(k) plan to help secure your financial future. The company also provides competitive compensation packages, flexible remote work arrangements, and opportunities for career advancement through continuous learning and development programs. V\-Soft fosters a collaborative and innovative work environment, encouraging employees to contribute ideas and grow within the organization. Additionally, employees gain access to a variety of resources, including mentorship programs, technical training, and participation in cutting\-edge projects that enhance their skills and industry knowledge.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 V\-Soft Consulting Group Inc is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. The company prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. V\-Soft believes in fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and every individual is treated with respect and fairness. The organization actively promotes a culture of equal opportunity and strives to create a supportive environment for all employees to thrive and succeed.

**You sit at the intersection of platform engineering, LLMOps/AgentOps, and applied AI. You care as much about auditability, traceability, and reliability as you do about capability. Your north star is moving the organization beyond isolated LLM demos toward governed, observable, production\-grade agent systems that deliver measurable business value. **.**

**Senior role. will be interfacing with senior leadership in the company**

description_preview:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
   

  

**SOFTWARE ENGINEER** 
**(PLATFORM TEAM)**
 The Platform Team is responsible for building the foundational tooling and security infrastructure that empowers every team at SpaceX to harness AI effectively. This team creates secure, scalable gateways and proxy systems that allow engineers and operators across the company to write code faster, perform advanced data analysis, connect AI to their daily tools and problems, and turn ideas into deployed solutions with confidence. By onboarding new frontier models, expanding compute capacity, optimizing proxy efficiency for logging and control, and building shared products, prompts, skills, and infrastructure, this team unlocks reliable, high\-impact AI capabilities across the entire organization.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer for SpaceX's AI platform, you will act as an entrepreneurial builder focused on the leanest and most effective applied use of AI at SpaceX. You will design platforms that convert engineering know\-how into tested software, automation, and reliable data stores at scale while creating risk\-mitigation tools such as intelligent code review and PR assistants. Current systems are built with Docker containers acting as secure gateways and proxies that integrate with any cloud compute provider and multiple frontier model providers. Your work will directly accelerate SpaceX production and development by enabling every team to move faster with trustworthy AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and operate secure, scalable AI platforms and proxy systems used by teams throughout SpaceX
* Own the full lifecycle of platform development including design, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement
* Drive adoption by communicating value, directly supporting engineers, and building shared prompts, skills, and infrastructure that accelerate peers
* Act entrepreneurially to identify high\-value opportunities and create solutions that allow users to rapidly turn problems and ideas into tested software, deployed applications, and trained models on managed, reliable compute
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders to deeply understand needs and deliver platforms that connect AI to real tools and workflows
* Onboard new models, expand compute resources, and optimize efficiency of proxy systems for logging, control, and security
